How does turret tracking math work when firing at high transversal targets in EVE?

• Tracking Equation: Chance to Hit = 0.5 ^ ( ((Transversal Velocity / (Range * Tracking)) * (Signature Resolution / Target Signature Radius))^2 + ((max(0, Range - Optimal) / Falloff)^2) ).
• Transversal Speed: Angular speed across your guns. If target transversal exceeds your turret tracking speed (rad/s), your hit chance drops to zero ('Wrecking' -> 'Glancing' -> 'Miss').
• Mitigation Tactics: Match target vector (fly parallel to match speed and lower transversal), fit Tracking Computers / Tracking Enhancers with tracking scripts, or apply Stasis Webifiers to reduce target velocity.

How does missile damage application work against fast, small targets?

• Damage Application Formula: Missile Damage = Base Damage * min(1, Target Sig / Explosion Radius, ( (Target Sig / Explosion Radius) * (Explosion Velocity / Target Velocity) )^Damage Reduction Factor ).

• Mitigation: Use Target Painters to bloom target signature radius, and Stasis Webifiers to reduce target velocity to near zero.
